notes.title: Patch Notes v0.0.26
notes.notes:
Hello furballs!

We’ve been busy tinkering behind the scenes to make your games smoother, faster, and more explosive than ever! 💥😼 

This update includes key fixes, performance improvements, and some tweaks based on your feedback.

 What’s New?

 Fixed a leaderboard bug
 Game now remembers the last game's customisation settings
 Various performance optimisations
 Adjusted game speed in certain game moments based on player feedback
 Fixed reconnection issues
 Fixed action timer reset issues
 Fixed an issue regarding cancelling a nope on a steal when there are no cards left to steal
 AI behaviour Improvements
 Made leaving game text clearer
 Improved the endgame flow and leaderboard screen
 General bug fixes

Keep the feedback coming, and let us know if you spot anything else that needs tweaking!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.16
notes.notes:
Hey Furballs!

We’ve got a pawsome update for you, packed with shiny improvements that’ll make your gameplay smoother, faster, and, of course, more explode-y. 💥

Here’s what’s new:

 Improved animations and lighting for a smoother gameplay experience.
 Adjusted animation timing for better flow during play.
 Increased AI speed for faster turns.
 Bug fixing and polishing of several game moments


We love hearing from you, so let us know what you think of the changes in the comments below!

Thanks again for all your awesome feedback and support. It's what keeps us going! 😸

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.15
notes.notes:
Hello Furballs!

Thank you for the incredible support during the launch of Exploding Kittens® 2! We’ve been gathering up your feedback and dropping a bunch of improvements in the last few patches. Here's some of what we've been working on:

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a few visual issues on 4:3 resolution devices
 Fixed an issue where cards could become stuck
 Fixed incorrect text showing when using a Favor card
 Fixed an issue with the card combo that could cause the game to become stuck
 Added a 'Skip' button in the Single Player game set-up, allowing players to skip the set-up animation
 Various animation tweaks and fixes
 Various improvements to the game's stability
 And, of course, we're also working on new content and features, such as the Turn Timer, which should be added in the next update! ⏲️ 

Thank you again for all your support and feedback so far! We'll continue doing our best to improve the game and make sure that every kitten explosion is as purrfect as possible. Stay tuned for more, and when in doubt, just Nope! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2999030/Exploding_Kittens_2/

notes.title: Update 0.10
notes.notes:
We wanted to thank you all for the incredible support during the launch of Exploding Kittens® 2! We’ve been gathering up your feedback, and with your help, we’ve been able to deploy several fixes already.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue where AI sometimes wouldn't use a defuse when they had one.
- Fixed some Multiplayer stability issues that prevented joining a new lobby.
- Fixed an issue where the Leaderboards would show incorrectly.

And that’s not all! We’re working hard to get more fixes out the door as soon as possible, namely:
- Fixing the infamous Shuffle lock in Multiplayer.
- Adjust the speed of gameplay/animations.

Developing games isn't easy, but your passion really keeps us going. Thank you for your patience as we continue working to make this game purrfect – or explode trying!

Please keep reporting any issues or suggestions you may have to help us further improve the game via the Community Hub, Discord or help@marmalademail.com.
